node_about: Keeps your ymls in a folder on this computer and runs plugin workers, for the apps you use it with.
node_gone: gestalts-node isn't running. Start it again; this page picks up where it was.
node_reload: Apps using the node reload with the other folder's ymls.
node_uv_downloading: Downloading uv, which runs the plugins…
node_first: Your data lives in a folder on this computer, as plain files you can back up and sync like any others. Choose an empty folder to start, or one you've used before.
llm_hint_gemini: An API key from Google AI Studio. Its free tier is tried first when it comes first.
llm_hint_claude_cli: The claude command on this computer, with your Claude subscription. Slower to start.
llm_hint_openai: An API key from platform.openai.com; paid per use.
llm_about: Views that ask an LLM use these, top to bottom, skipping any that isn't set up or is rate-limited.
